SavingsRow.title: SavingsRow
SavingsRow.description: A single row in the 3-column Target Tabungan savings ledger (Tabungan, Nominal, Tanggal/Bulan/Tahun).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the row owner.

rowIndex.description: 1-based row number in the savings table (1..120).

tabungan.description: Column 1: Savings entry label or description.

nominal.description: Column 2: Savings amount in Indonesian Rupiah.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the row was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the row was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

TargetConfig.title: TargetConfig
TargetConfig.description: Configuration for the user's Target Tabungan table title, goal amount, and row count.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

targetAmount.description: Target total savings amount in Rupiah.

totalDataRows.description: Number of data rows in the table (default 60 data rows + 1 header row = 61 total rows).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the config was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the config was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).
